summary.text: Alice Wade is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives who has represented Strafford 15 since December 2024 and is running for re-election in Strafford 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Alice Wade earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire, and her career experience includes working as an aerospace engineer.

She was first elected in 2024, defeating Republican Keith Mistretta in the general election for Strafford 15, 2,047 votes (70.2%) to 869 (29.8%), after winning the Democratic primary over Lucas Veitch.
She succeeded Bill Conlin (D) and assumed office on December 4, 2024.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Strafford 21 on September 8, 2026, and Joseph Morganella is the Republican candidate in the three-seat district.
